title: StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometryExistence
statement: For any qcqs morphism f:X→S and geometric point s, the canonical small affine neighbourhood geometry [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry] exists. This asserts only the limit cone, qcqs stages, affine transitions and its prescribed projection equations.

source.place: Tags 03Q9, 03Q8 and 0BKV; neighbourhood colimit and final injective-complex paragraph

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-base-change-cone] to f and s. Its small diagram is definitionally the canonical strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram. Extend the resulting cone along pullbackSymmetry f (strictHenselizationStructuralMap s). Transport IsLimit with Cone.extendIso. Precompose both projection equations with the symmetry and simplify to obtain the required first and over equations.

Every stage neighbourhood is a spectrum and therefore affine, compact and quasi-separated. The first projection from its pullback along f is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by base-change stability. Apply Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace and AlgebraicGeometry.quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated to this projection to obtain the required stage properties.

For a neighbourhood transition, install the two spectrum affineness instances. The map is affine by Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.isAffineHom_of_isAffine. Its stage transition is the pullback lift, so Mathlib CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.pullbackLift_fst_snd with P = IsAffineHom and the over-category commutativity equation proves it affine. Assemble these fields with the transported cone into StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight results about structure-sheaf stalks and ordinary module pullback; none realizes these abelian derived-section maps. Loogle presheafToSheaf, homology and IsPullback, IsAffineHom queries returned no hits.

Mathlib has general stalk and pullback infrastructure, but no strict-local derived mate or the canonical derived Hom-to-germ comparison. The existing AbelianHigherDirectImagePresheaf has private definitions of the comparison, inaccessible from another module.
